messages:
Alex: Hey @Priya — dropping a lightweight first-week playbook + a fillable 30/60/90 template you can copy. Use this for Sam's onboarding. :tada:

Alex:
```
Week 1 (high level):
- Day 0: IT package, 1Password invite, Slack + email + GSuite
- Day 1: Team intros (30m), product overview (1h), setup dev laptop, access review
- Day 2: Infra walkthrough (45m), small env setup task, 1:1 expectations (30m)
- Day 3: Shadow pairing, first small ticket
- Day 4: Deep dive on runtime + serving, docs tour
- Day 5: Recap 1:1, blocker list, plan next two weeks

Manager checklist (week 1):
- Add to team calendar events
- Invite to #eng, #eng-runtime, #oncall-rotations if applicable
- Assign a buddy
- Set 30/60/90 goals draft
- Security training & SSO/MFA ok

30/60/90 template (copy & paste):
- 30 days: Learn product, ship first small PR, join two core meetings
- 60 days: Own a feature area, reduce onboarding docs gaps, start perf/runbook
- 90 days: Lead rollout + be primary on one oncall rotation, propose optimization
```

Alex: Quick notes: add to 1Password (category: Onboarding), enable MFA, and share calendar invites with "focus" blocks. For Dedicated access, raise an eng-infra ticket (label: "dedicated-setup").

Priya: Super helpful — thanks. Two q's: 1) who does hardware shipping follow-up? 2) Is there a checklist for compliance training deadlines? :thinking:

Alex: Hardware -> IT Support (cc'd). I just opened a ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/3456 (I'll paste updates). Compliance training: OnboardingBot will DM reminders; target is EOD day 3 for basic and day 14 for full.

OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled: Security Foundations course must be completed by 2026-04-01. You'll get a DM and follow-ups. :bell:

Sam: Hey team — laptop shows as "shipped" but not delivered. ETA? Also, where do I find the starter issues to pick from?

IT Support: Hi Sam — checking carrier now. Please confirm shipping address in #help or DM me. Starter issues are in the repo: https://git.redwood.ai/onboarding/labels/first-timers

Priya: I'll block 30/60/90 review on week 2 Friday (30-day retrospective). Does that work for everyone? :calendar:

Alex: Works for me. I'll update the template to include meeting invites and a bulleted doc for the buddy. I'll also attach a fillable Google Doc after this thread. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Thanks all — ready to dive in. Appreciate the clear playbook. :rocket:
